# Mikuni PHH Carburetor Service Manual — Overview

This is a service manual for **Mikuni PHH twin-choke carburetors**, specifically the
40PHH and 44PHH models. It belongs on the Shop Shelf as a **component manual** under
Mikuni, rather than under any one vehicle or engine. The kit application table near
the end names several makes and engines, but those are examples of installations,
not the scope of the service procedures.

## What the source covers

- Carburetor purpose, features, model selection, construction, and operation.
- Float, pilot, main, accelerator-pump, and starter systems.
- Mounting, idle adjustment, starting, overhaul, maintenance, fuel-level inspection,
  and tuning.
- Troubleshooting, exploded views, parts lists, jetting information, and gasket kits.
- Additional application, kit, and accessory listings at the end of the scan.

## Scope and provenance

- **Source:** 31-page PDF titled *PHH Carburetor Service Manual* on the cover
  (source PDF p. 1).
- **Publisher:** Mikuni American Corporation; the source carries a 1979 copyright
  statement (source PDF p. 29).
- **Models:** 40PHH and 44PHH, identified in the manual's model-selection section
  (source PDF p. 4). The parts list names particular 40PHH and 44PHH variants;
  applicability of a procedure or part should be checked against its own table.
- **Not covered:** Complete vehicle or engine service. The mounting and application
  information does not make this a service manual for any specific car or engine.
- **Scan note:** The cover is image-only; the remaining pages contain extractable text
  with visible OCR errors. Numeric settings, part numbers, and diagram callouts need
  page-image verification during conversion.
